Subject: Post-discovery recap + schedule technical review / attendee roster

Hi Sam —

Great to speak earlier. Quick recap from our 30-minute discovery:
- Primary use case: serve clinical-document summarization for provider workflows (short form, ~150–400 tokens per note)
- Key SLOs: <100ms p50 generation for 150-token prompts; p95 <350ms.
- Data controls: logs retention, tenant isolation, and on-prem option are evaluation criteria.
- Success metric for POC: 50% reduction in clinician edit time on sampled notes across two specialties.

Next step we agreed on: 45-minute technical review with your engineering and security leads so we can:
  1) Walk through inference latency profiling and estimated cost for your workload
  2) Share model/quantization options and fallback routing for availability
  3) Align on integration touchpoints (keys, telemetry, KV cache behavior)

Proposed 45-minute slots (PDT):
- Tue, Jun 15 — 10:00–10:45
- Wed, Jun 16 — 14:00–14:45
- Thu, Jun 17 — 08:30–09:15

Proposed attendees (from Redwood): Tessa (solutions), Aditya (inference eng), Priyom (solutions engineer).
Please confirm which slot works and who from MedSync will join (security, infra, product, etc.). If none work, share 2 windows that do. Once we lock a time I'll send the calendar invite + Zoom link and attach a short mutual action plan.

Attachments: discovery-notes-20260607.pdf (summary) and redwood-suggested-agenda.md (proposed agenda).

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
